tools.name: search_providers

tools.name: get_provider
tools.description: Read all supplied fields for one provider. Missing listings do not imply a company does not exist.

tools.name: similar_providers
tools.description: Find providers similar to a directory listing.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List directory categories, cities or services with counts.

tools.name: directory_stats
tools.description: Read directory totals and the twenty largest categories.

tools.name: search_content
tools.description: Search articles, news and opinion, or return the latest content.

tools.name: get_content
tools.description: Read an article, news story or opinion piece, with its citation.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search providers and editorial content for company knowledge.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Fetch a provider or editorial result by its search identifier.

tools.name: site_guide
tools.description: Read the site guide and its guidance on available content.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
